input_types: UTF-8 JSON object containing two or three complete bounded Crossref, OpenAlex, or Europe PMC topic-search receipts; each retains provider identity, endpoint, query/response hashes, bounded records, and counts.
required_outputs: Offline normalized source summaries and exact normalized DOI cross-index groups; same-title or same-year records are never merged.
Exact normalized-title records with multiple distinct valid DOIs surfaced as review-only candidates; warnings never create identity groups.
